title: Nutty Crisp Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A keto-friendly Argentinian dish featuring crispy empanadas filled with beef and nuts, perfect for a sick day. The earthy flavors and crunchy texture will transport you to the streets of Buenos Aires.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Stir in the sliced almonds and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked beef mixture to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Roll out the empanada dough and use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Spoon a small amount of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, pressing the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of olive oil and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
